logical_removal.read: No general source tombstone API; surface-specific soft state governs availability.
logical_removal.cleanup: Lifecycle state changes do not imply deletion.
logical_removal.restore: Older backups can resurrect state; replay approved removals before serving.
logical_removal.coverage: Gap: no general logical-removal/restore conformance suite.

physical_erasure.read: No general source erasure API or deadline.
physical_erasure.cleanup: Provider/operator backup retention is independent. DB restore omits external source/evidence/L2 bytes.

physical_erasure.restore: Restore in isolation; replay exclusions/revocations/removals/holds/purges before traffic. No durable denial journal.
physical_erasure.coverage: Gap: no end-to-end backup/restore erasure fixture; environment-specific drill required.

protected_retention.read: Retained for provenance/operations under current endpoint authority; not a general regulatory retention API.

protected_retention.restore: Preserve identities/provenance; reconcile external bytes separately.
protected_retention.coverage: History fixtures prove their stated invariants, not general retention deadlines.

retrieval_exclusion.read: Original bytes remain; collection retirement/exclusion does not delete sources shared by another collection.
retrieval_exclusion.holds: No general source hold API; pins and other collection owners can require content.
retrieval_exclusion.restore: Reconcile exclusions before serving an older restore; no general denial journal exists.
retrieval_exclusion.coverage: Gap: no universal exclusion fixture across all surfaces.

access_revocation.read: Original-reference routes recheck collection authority; raw source/store paths have their own scopes.
access_revocation.restore: Reconcile restored deny-list, grants and policies before serving.

physical_erasure.read: No general source erasure API or deadline.
physical_erasure.cleanup: Raw source bytes follow separately authorized operator cleanup with shared-owner review. Reserved evidence/<id> bytes also use this table under pg SourceStore and follow existing delete-before-mark evidence purge; manifests/audit remain in their separate tables.
physical_erasure.holds: No general raw-source hold API. Evidence paths use evidence legal_hold checks with the documented scan/delete race; consult the evidence policy.
physical_erasure.restore: No durable erasure journal/replay contract; restored state cannot claim general erasure compliance.
physical_erasure.coverage: Existing source-store deletion and evidence purge fixtures cover their named paths. Gap: no cross-surface source/evidence/backup erasure closure.

protected_retention.read: Raw source copies remain for every owning collection; reserved evidence bytes remain under the evidence-only retention/hold rules.
protected_retention.holds: Evidence holds are separate; other surfaces have no general legal-hold API.
protected_retention.restore: Preserve identities/provenance; reconcile external bytes separately.
protected_retention.coverage: History fixtures prove their stated invariants, not general retention deadlines.
